playwright_config.note: Extended viewport required to capture full grid wrap and deep course card list.

bugs.report_text: The course cards are displaying in a narrow two-column layout on large screens instead of three columns, causing excessive wrapping and poor space utilization.
The course card content is touching the card edges without any internal spacing or breathing room.
The instructor name text is too dark to read against the dark card background, creating poor contrast and illegibility.
The lesson item styling is broken with an invalid style applied causing unexpected rendering behavior.
The inactive lesson title text appears too bright and harsh, creating excessive contrast with the dark interface and reducing visual hierarchy.
The navigation bar is being hidden behind other content elements as the page scrolls down.

bugs.report_text: The navigation menu items are stacking vertically instead of appearing in a horizontal row on medium and larger screens.
The tab content container has an invalid style applied preventing proper rounded corners from displaying.
The video player is creating excessive downward overlap with the content below it, causing visual collision and misalignment.
